body:
When `/api/v1/books` fails, the catalog renders the **empty-state component** —
the same books glyph used for "No books here." — and substitutes the raw error
text for the empty message. Measured live at 1440px, dark theme, 16s after load
(react-query retries settle by ~15s; 8 requests total):

    fulfill 500 body {"error":"boom"}  ->  page shows:  [books icon]  boom
    fulfill 503 body {"error":"down"}  ->  page shows:  [books icon]  down
    route.abort("failed")              ->  page shows:  [books icon]  Failed to fetch

Four problems, in order of how much they cost a user:

1. **It is visually indistinguishable from an empty library.** Same icon, same
   layout, same position. A user whose server is erroring sees the shape that
   means "you own no books".
2. **The message is a machine string, not a sentence.** "boom", "down" and
   "Failed to fetch" tell a non-technical user nothing. There is no "Couldn't
   load your library" framing anywhere.
3. **No retry affordance**, even though react-query has by then exhausted its
   own retries — so the only recovery is a manual page reload the UI never
   suggests. (The toolbar's refresh button is still there but is not presented
   as the fix.)
4. **Backend error text reaches the UI verbatim.** Whatever the API puts in
   `error` is printed to the page. Benign here; it is the wrong default.

Caveat on how this was found, because it nearly went in wrong: an earlier pass
searched the DOM for words like "error"/"failed"/"try again" and concluded a 500
produced **no error state at all**. It does — the state just contains the
server's own word, which matches no error vocabulary. Detecting error states by
keyword is unreliable; diff the rendered content region against a baseline load
instead.

Also checked in the same pass and CORRECT, recorded so nobody re-derives them:
very long titles clamp to two lines with ellipsis and the author truncates on
one line, with no overflow at 390px or 1440px; and books with **no cover
recorded** render the designed NEXTGEN fallback properly (the broken *load* case
is separate — F-8f8a5b).

Method + full inventory: `notes/UI-SWEEP-INVENTORY.md` (outer workspace).
title: The library's failure state is the raw server error string in an empty-state shell
